name: IDream Film Infrastructure Company Limited
summary: IDream Film Infrastructure Company Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the software development business. The company was formerly known as SoftBPO Global Services Limited and changed its name to IDream Film Infrastructure Company Limited in December 2009. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India. IDream Film Infrastructure Company Limited is a subsidiary of AHA Holdings Private Limited.
